gaps.sentence: I'll call you as soon ___ I land.
If I ___ you, I'd apologise immediately.
gaps.explanation: 'If I were you' — subjunctive 'were' for unreal situations.

gaps.sentence: He prefers cycling ___ driving to work.
___ of the two passwords works — try the other one.
gaps.hint: not one and not the other
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of the two' = not either of them.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ laughing at his accent.
He ___ the flu last week and missed the finals.
gaps.explanation: 'catch the flu/a cold' = become ill with it.
Past perfect for the earlier of two past moments.

gaps.sentence: This time tomorrow we ___ flying to Rome.
gaps.explanation: Future continuous: will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time.
